The [[Paranoia Ettin]] is an [[Ettin]] [[boss]] that appears on the first level of [[Bloodstone Caves]]. It drops the [[Dungeon Key]] for that level. Killing the Paranoia Ettin and retrieving a [[Shimmering Essence]] is the objective of the quest [[The Blade's Essence]].

== Location ==
* [[Depths of Tyria]]
** {{NPC location|Bloodstone Caves}} (level 1)

== Skills ==
* {{skill icon|Backbreaker}} ([[elite]])
* {{skill icon|Counter Blow}}
* {{skill icon|Crude Swing}}
* {{skill icon|Pulverizing Smash}}
* {{skill icon|Paranoid Indignation}} ([[monster skill]])

== Items dropped ==
* [[Dungeon Key]]
* [[Ettin Club]] ([[unique]])
* [[Shimmering essence|Shimmering Essence]] (only dropped during [[The Blade's Essence]])

== Notes ==
* This Ettin's [[patrol]] path sometimes causes it to be struck by a nearby Flame Trap, which in turn can cause its death.
